note: OPEN frames — constructed positions of thought on the approved atlas vocab; seed each on its 8 value-DEFINITIONS (included). Complementary to Mark ∪ the 6 Christian personas.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: Known through doing it. The warrant is the disciplined activity itself: repeated performance is what makes the claim evident, independent of any bodily skill acquired.
definitions.ontological-commitment: Two or more irreducible kinds are fundamental; no single substance grounds the rest.
definitions.inferential-operation: Explains by cause and effect: the conclusion is reached by identifying what produces what.
definitions.telos: Capability as an end in itself, not as a means.
definitions.evaluative-stance: The text's posture toward its object is ironic — it means other than, or against, what it literally says; a detached or subverting attitude. DISTINCT from a stated contradiction (B1 gap-irony) and from an audience-character knowledge gap (Sitz dramatic-irony): this is the STANCE layer only. See three_layer_irony_distinction_s157.
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: The surface hides a mechanism. Digs beneath the text for the real cause or interest it does not declare.
definitions.r_topology: Nominally distinct parties whose boundaries are insufficiently differentiated. Family-systems codependence.
definitions.r_condition: One provides a bounded field in which another's unmanageable states are borne and returned tolerable.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: You see it yourself. Direct, unmediated sensory access, with no witness between the knower and the known.
definitions.ontological-commitment: One substance under two irreducible aspects; mind and matter are two faces of one ground.
definitions.inferential-operation: Infers the best explanation: from a surprising fact, reasons back to what would, if true, make it a matter of course.
definitions.telos: The actualisation of persons: a life going well in its own terms.
definitions.evaluative-stance: Approaches the object with warmth, care, and protective gentleness — a cherishing, vulnerable regard (distinct from reverent=awe and charitable=good-faith).
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: Treats the text as an ACT to be enacted/performed (ritual, liturgical, legal, dramatic, sung) — its meaning is in the DOING, not only the interpreting.
definitions.r_topology: The higher arises from the lower with no prior ground. A directional, bottom-up order.
definitions.r_condition: Sustained non-coercive attention toward an other who has not yet answered. Distinct from beloved-seeking (which reaches) and from dependence (which is supported): this one holds open without acting.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: Direct intellectual apprehension. The truth is grasped whole, without inference and without sensory mediation.
definitions.ontological-commitment: The passage actively refuses to commit and holds the refusal as its position. Requires an explicit refusal-marker in the text (this cannot be said; one neither affirms nor denies); absent that marker, code not-asserted.
definitions.inferential-operation: Generalises from instances: many observed cases license a claim about the unobserved.
definitions.telos: Release. Something binds (craving, ignorance, bondage, structure) and is loosed. The end is freedom from, not the repair of a relation.
definitions.evaluative-stance: Regards the object as withholding something: reads for what it does not say.
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: The surface grammatical sense is the meaning. The text means what it plainly says; no hidden layer, symbol, or subtext is sought. A claim about semantic depth, not a refusal to interpret.
definitions.r_topology: Each party's contribution structurally calls for, and is answered by, the other's. Mutual exchange between parties who remain distinct. NOT dependent-arising, which is causal co-origination.
definitions.r_condition: Stable balance without clinging or rejection; boundaries permeable, self not dissolved.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: Known in the body. The warrant is tacit, non-propositional bodily competence: a trained skill or attunement that can be demonstrated but not fully stated.
definitions.ontological-commitment: Experience is a fundamental feature of all things, distributed through matter, not necessarily prior to it.
definitions.inferential-operation: Advances by negation: the conclusion emerges from setting a claim against its contradiction.
definitions.telos: Right order among parts. The end is the structural relation among many, not a bond with any single one.
definitions.evaluative-stance: Approaches the object as something to resist or stand against — an oppositional posture (Job before God; a prophet before power; a liberation text before authority).
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: The surface plus. Reads generously, assembles, repairs, seeks what the text can be made to sustain.
definitions.r_topology: The parties are each constituted AS WHAT THEY ARE through the relation; neither exists prior to it. NOT identity (they remain two) and NOT participation (which presumes pre-existing entities).
definitions.r_condition: An originating gift, perpetual gratitude, and an asymmetric indebtedness never fully discharged.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: Someone else tells you. The warrant is mediated: it rests on a living witness who saw, and the knower is not the one who did.
definitions.ontological-commitment: Emptiness is fundamental. There is no self-standing substance at bottom; all things are empty of own-being. The emptiness is asserted as the positive claim.
definitions.inferential-operation: Deduces from premises already accepted: the conclusion follows necessarily from first principles, regardless of where those principles came from (even if scriptural).
definitions.telos: Understanding is the end, not the warrant for something else.
definitions.evaluative-stance: Regards the object as owed good faith: reads for the strongest available sense. An interpretive default, not deference to authority.
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: Treats the text as an ACT to be enacted/performed (ritual, liturgical, legal, dramatic, sung) — its meaning is in the DOING, not only the interpreting.
definitions.r_topology: The world is the ground. Any difference is apparent; at bottom they are numerically one, with no remainder.
definitions.r_condition: Shaped by shared suffering plus an active urge to alleviate it.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: It is disclosed. A truth given from outside the natural order, received passively, with no procedure of interpretation standing between the source and the knower.
definitions.ontological-commitment: The passage actively refuses to commit and holds the refusal as its position. Requires an explicit refusal-marker in the text (this cannot be said; one neither affirms nor denies); absent that marker, code not-asserted.
definitions.inferential-operation: Explains by cause and effect: the conclusion is reached by identifying what produces what.
definitions.telos: Obedience, duty, worship, preservation. The marker: the end is not the agent own benefit.
definitions.evaluative-stance: Approaches the object as something to resist or stand against — an oppositional posture (Job before God; a prophet before power; a liberation text before authority).
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: Treats the text as an ACT to be enacted/performed (ritual, liturgical, legal, dramatic, sung) — its meaning is in the DOING, not only the interpreting.
definitions.r_topology: Owed because of the position occupied, not the personal bond. Owed even if the person is unworthy.
definitions.r_condition: A relation sustained as non-instrumental mutual PLAY — the interaction is its own point, with no telos, debt, repair, or rescue in view; the freedom of both parties is constitutive. Distinct from communion (presence), reciprocity (exchange), equanimous-nonattachment (affect). Home cases: Vaishnava lila (creation as God's sport), Proverbs 8:30-31 (Wisdom playing/delighting before God), Krishna rasa-lila, Winnicott's play-space.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: Known in the body. The warrant is tacit, non-propositional bodily competence: a trained skill or attunement that can be demonstrated but not fully stated.
definitions.ontological-commitment: An impersonal order is fundamental. The ground is a law or pattern, not an agent.
definitions.inferential-operation: Transfers structure from one domain to another: A is to B as C is to D. The conclusion rides on the likeness.
definitions.telos: The aim of ongoing membership and acceptance — having a PLACE with an other or a group, WITHOUT merger (covenant, family, tradition). Distinct from communion (union) and salvation (rescue).
definitions.evaluative-stance: Approaches the object with warmth, care, and protective gentleness — a cherishing, vulnerable regard (distinct from reverent=awe and charitable=good-faith).
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: The surface grammatical sense is the meaning. The text means what it plainly says; no hidden layer, symbol, or subtext is sought. A claim about semantic depth, not a refusal to interpret.
definitions.r_topology: The ground shows itself as the world in one immediate display, with no graded levels; a remainder holds between the hidden ground and its visible appearance.
definitions.r_condition: Each encounters the other as a separate centre of experience while being so encountered.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: Known by becoming one with the object. The knower and the known collapse into one.
definitions.ontological-commitment: Awareness is fundamental. Mind is not produced by matter; matter is a content of mind. Mind is the single ground, not a property distributed through things.
definitions.inferential-operation: Generalises from instances: many observed cases license a claim about the unobserved.
definitions.telos: Love, union, belonging. The end is a dyadic bond with an other.
definitions.evaluative-stance: Regards the object as sacred or authoritative: approached with deference and awe, as something that may make a claim on the reader.
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: Treats the text as an ACT to be enacted/performed (ritual, liturgical, legal, dramatic, sung) — its meaning is in the DOING, not only the interpreting.
definitions.r_topology: One occupies the subject position; the other is positioned as object, instrument or extension. Buber's I-It pole.
definitions.r_condition: Respond without imposing will: asymmetric but not dominating, responsive rather than generative.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: Someone else tells you. The warrant is mediated: it rests on a living witness who saw, and the knower is not the one who did.
definitions.ontological-commitment: An impersonal order is fundamental. The ground is a law or pattern, not an agent.
definitions.inferential-operation: Infers the best explanation: from a surprising fact, reasons back to what would, if true, make it a matter of course.
definitions.telos: Love, union, belonging. The end is a dyadic bond with an other.
definitions.evaluative-stance: Regards the object as withholding something: reads for what it does not say.
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: The surface hides a mechanism. Digs beneath the text for the real cause or interest it does not declare.
definitions.r_topology: Two parties positioned as competitors for something that cannot be simultaneously possessed.
definitions.r_condition: Constituted by the ethical demand of the other's vulnerability; self as debtor without reciprocity.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: It has been handed down. The warrant is inheritance: the claim is licensed because a tradition, community, or institution holds and transmits it, not because any single living witness saw it. Covers received tradition, communal consensus (ijma, sangha), and institutional authority.
definitions.ontological-commitment: Reality is constituted through relations of PARTICIPATION — beings are neither identical with ultimate reality (union) nor merely separate substances (dualism/pluralism), but partake in it. Distinct from the substance-based ontology values. Home cases: theosis (2 Peter 1:4, partakers of the divine nature), Ibn Arabi tajalli, Neoplatonic emanation/methexis.
definitions.inferential-operation: Transfers structure from one domain to another: A is to B as C is to D. The conclusion rides on the likeness.
definitions.telos: Capability as an end in itself, not as a means.
definitions.evaluative-stance: Regards the object as withholding something: reads for what it does not say.
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: The surface plus. Reads generously, assembles, repairs, seeks what the text can be made to sustain.
definitions.r_topology: Things arise in mutual, symmetric dependence, with no independent ground and no privileged lower level. Nothing stands on its own.
definitions.r_condition: Shaped by shared suffering plus an active urge to alleviate it.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: You see it yourself. Direct, unmediated sensory access, with no witness between the knower and the known.
definitions.ontological-commitment: Matter is fundamental. What is most real is physical stuff; everything else is its arrangement.
definitions.inferential-operation: Advances by negation: the conclusion emerges from setting a claim against its contradiction.
definitions.telos: Emancipation or reform of a shared world. The end is collective and external, not individual release.

definitions.r_topology: Living, dead and unborn held as one topology across time; asymmetric yet binding.
definitions.r_condition: Respond without imposing will: asymmetric but not dominating, responsive rather than generative.

definitions.r_topology: The relation does not exist prior to its performance; right form constitutes it.
definitions.r_condition: The relation IS the continuing process of seeking accord; processual, not static.

definitions.ontological-commitment: The ground is beyond all predication. It cannot be said to be substance, process, or even empty; the fundamental is unsayable.
definitions.inferential-operation: Transfers structure from one domain to another: A is to B as C is to D. The conclusion rides on the likeness.

definitions.r_topology: A one-time passage that permanently changes what the parties are to each other.
definitions.r_condition: Oriented toward union while preserving the distinction between the one who seeks and the one sought. The relation IS the reaching; consummation would end it. Simone Weil's *Waiting for God*; the Psalms' 'my soul waits'; bhakti *viraha* (love-in-separation as devotional discipline); Augustine's restless heart.

definitions.r_condition: An asymmetric opening of a boundary that receives the other without dissolving the distinction between them.

definitions.r_topology: A third party who, on behalf of one principal, actively presses the other toward restoration. Not neutral, not merely a channel — partisan and pressing. Distinct from mediated-triadic (a third position that STABILISES) and from witness (a third who only observes).
definitions.r_condition: Stable balance without clinging or rejection; boundaries permeable, self not dissolved.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: You see it yourself. Direct, unmediated sensory access, with no witness between the knower and the known.
definitions.ontological-commitment: Emptiness is fundamental. There is no self-standing substance at bottom; all things are empty of own-being. The emptiness is asserted as the positive claim.
definitions.inferential-operation: Explains by cause and effect: the conclusion is reached by identifying what produces what.
definitions.telos: Emancipation or reform of a shared world. The end is collective and external, not individual release.
definitions.evaluative-stance: Regards the object as withholding something: reads for what it does not say.
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: The surface hides a mechanism. Digs beneath the text for the real cause or interest it does not declare.
definitions.r_topology: A party utters, in the first person, words commissioned by an absent principal. The third lends a mouth so an absent party's own voice reaches the addressee — a conduit for VOICE, not a position that stabilises.
definitions.r_condition: An originating gift, perpetual gratitude, and an asymmetric indebtedness never fully discharged.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: Someone else tells you. The warrant is mediated: it rests on a living witness who saw, and the knower is not the one who did.
definitions.ontological-commitment: Two or more irreducible kinds are fundamental; no single substance grounds the rest.
definitions.inferential-operation: Infers the best explanation: from a surprising fact, reasons back to what would, if true, make it a matter of course.
definitions.telos: Obedience, duty, worship, preservation. The marker: the end is not the agent own benefit.
definitions.evaluative-stance: The text's posture toward its object is ironic — it means other than, or against, what it literally says; a detached or subverting attitude. DISTINCT from a stated contradiction (B1 gap-irony) and from an audience-character knowledge gap (Sitz dramatic-irony): this is the STANCE layer only. See three_layer_irony_distinction_s157.
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: The surface plus. Reads generously, assembles, repairs, seeks what the text can be made to sustain.
definitions.r_topology: Living, dead and unborn held as one topology across time; asymmetric yet binding.
definitions.r_condition: Sustained non-coercive attention toward an other who has not yet answered. Distinct from beloved-seeking (which reaches) and from dependence (which is supported): this one holds open without acting.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: Direct intellectual apprehension. The truth is grasped whole, without inference and without sensory mediation.
definitions.ontological-commitment: One substance under two irreducible aspects; mind and matter are two faces of one ground.
definitions.inferential-operation: Generalises from instances: many observed cases license a claim about the unobserved.
definitions.telos: Love, union, belonging. The end is a dyadic bond with an other.
definitions.evaluative-stance: Approaches the object with warmth, care, and protective gentleness — a cherishing, vulnerable regard (distinct from reverent=awe and charitable=good-faith).
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: The surface plus. Reads generously, assembles, repairs, seeks what the text can be made to sustain.
definitions.r_topology: Irreversible origination plus mutual obligation flowing in opposite directions; the child chooses the obligation.
definitions.r_condition: Each encounters the other as a separate centre of experience while being so encountered.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: Someone else tells you. The warrant is mediated: it rests on a living witness who saw, and the knower is not the one who did.
definitions.ontological-commitment: Matter is fundamental. What is most real is physical stuff; everything else is its arrangement.
definitions.inferential-operation: Transfers structure from one domain to another: A is to B as C is to D. The conclusion rides on the likeness.
definitions.telos: Right order among parts. The end is the structural relation among many, not a bond with any single one.
definitions.evaluative-stance: Regards the object as sacred or authoritative: approached with deference and awe, as something that may make a claim on the reader.
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: Treats the text as an ACT to be enacted/performed (ritual, liturgical, legal, dramatic, sung) — its meaning is in the DOING, not only the interpreting.
definitions.r_topology: Nominally distinct parties whose boundaries are insufficiently differentiated. Family-systems codependence.
definitions.r_condition: Constituted by the ethical demand of the other's vulnerability; self as debtor without reciprocity.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: Known in the body. The warrant is tacit, non-propositional bodily competence: a trained skill or attunement that can be demonstrated but not fully stated.
definitions.ontological-commitment: Two or more irreducible kinds are fundamental; no single substance grounds the rest.
definitions.inferential-operation: Generalises from instances: many observed cases license a claim about the unobserved.
definitions.telos: Release. Something binds (craving, ignorance, bondage, structure) and is loosed. The end is freedom from, not the repair of a relation.
definitions.evaluative-stance: Approaches the object with warmth, care, and protective gentleness — a cherishing, vulnerable regard (distinct from reverent=awe and charitable=good-faith).
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: Treats the text as an ACT to be enacted/performed (ritual, liturgical, legal, dramatic, sung) — its meaning is in the DOING, not only the interpreting.
definitions.r_topology: Things arise in mutual, symmetric dependence, with no independent ground and no privileged lower level. Nothing stands on its own.
definitions.r_condition: Parties distinct; channels of responsiveness structurally minimised or closed. Avoidant organisation.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: You see it yourself. Direct, unmediated sensory access, with no witness between the knower and the known.
definitions.ontological-commitment: An impersonal order is fundamental. The ground is a law or pattern, not an agent.
definitions.inferential-operation: Draws the conclusion out of an authoritative text. Bound to recovering a specific source meaning.
definitions.telos: Capability as an end in itself, not as a means.
definitions.evaluative-stance: The text's posture toward its object is ironic — it means other than, or against, what it literally says; a detached or subverting attitude. DISTINCT from a stated contradiction (B1 gap-irony) and from an audience-character knowledge gap (Sitz dramatic-irony): this is the STANCE layer only. See three_layer_irony_distinction_s157.
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: Treats the text as an ACT to be enacted/performed (ritual, liturgical, legal, dramatic, sung) — its meaning is in the DOING, not only the interpreting.
definitions.r_topology: Things arise in mutual, symmetric dependence, with no independent ground and no privileged lower level. Nothing stands on its own.
definitions.r_condition: A deliberate boundary that halts flow. Not absence — an active cut.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: Known in the body. The warrant is tacit, non-propositional bodily competence: a trained skill or attunement that can be demonstrated but not fully stated.
definitions.ontological-commitment: Awareness is fundamental. Mind is not produced by matter; matter is a content of mind. Mind is the single ground, not a property distributed through things.
definitions.inferential-operation: Draws the conclusion out of an authoritative text. Bound to recovering a specific source meaning.
definitions.telos: Love, union, belonging. The end is a dyadic bond with an other.
definitions.evaluative-stance: The text's posture toward its object is ironic — it means other than, or against, what it literally says; a detached or subverting attitude. DISTINCT from a stated contradiction (B1 gap-irony) and from an audience-character knowledge gap (Sitz dramatic-irony): this is the STANCE layer only. See three_layer_irony_distinction_s157.
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: The surface plus. Reads generously, assembles, repairs, seeks what the text can be made to sustain.
definitions.r_topology: Nominally distinct parties whose boundaries are insufficiently differentiated. Family-systems codependence.
definitions.r_condition: A bond that still exists and is severed. Not the instant of breaking — the sustained condition of being broken while still bound.

definitions.epistemic-warrant: It follows. The warrant is inferential: the claim is licensed by argument, not by access.
definitions.ontological-commitment: Awareness is fundamental. Mind is not produced by matter; matter is a content of mind. Mind is the single ground, not a property distributed through things.
definitions.inferential-operation: Infers the best explanation: from a surprising fact, reasons back to what would, if true, make it a matter of course.
definitions.telos: Capability as an end in itself, not as a means.
definitions.evaluative-stance: Approaches the object as something to resist or stand against — an oppositional posture (Job before God; a prophet before power; a liberation text before authority).
definitions.hermeneutic-posture: The surface hides a mechanism. Digs beneath the text for the real cause or interest it does not declare.
definitions.r_topology: One party's capacity to persist, act, or be regulated is structurally contingent on another's support.
definitions.r_condition: A bond that still exists and is severed. Not the instant of breaking — the sustained condition of being broken while still bound.

derivation.distance_metric: Hamming over the 8 categorical axes = (# axes where two positions differ) / 8 (0=identical, 1=differs on every axis).
derivation.d_dist_from_cloud: min over the 7 occupied positions (Mark + 6 personas) of Hamming(frame,pos). d=1.0 = differs from ALL 7 on ALL 8 axes (a corner none of our group holds).
derivation.coh_coherence: fraction of the frame's 28 axis-value pairs (8-choose-2) that co-occur >=1 across the approved-vocab atlas reads (1031 reads). coh=0.71 ~= 20/28 pairs corpus-attested = inhabitable, not nonsense.
derivation.selection: construct candidates from the approved vocab (each axis biased toward a value the cloud does NOT hold) -> keep d>=0.55 AND coh>=0.60 -> max-min farthest-point pick 35 to spread across the far region.

morphospace_plotting.instruction: plot as SUPPLEMENTARY points into the MCA (fit on the REAL reads) — different color, visually delineated from real reads. Do NOT include in the MCA fit.
morphospace_plotting.epistemics: a REAL dot is anchored on a specific WORK (concrete/narrow — this text, this idea); a CREATED dot is BROADER (a constructed stance, no work behind it). A created frame either fills EMPTY space (no real work there) or lands on/near a real dot (a real work holds that constructed position — a finding).
